Five principles of health are presented: (1) Health is the maintainable-ease of functioning; (2) Maintainable-ease of functioning emerges from multiple levels ; (3) At each level, maintainable-ease of functioning is generated by systems ;
Function parallels a state of “ease”; and maintainable-ease of functioning parallels the state of Health.

By considering health as maintainable-ease of functioning (rather than maintained biological structures) at multiple levels, we set a point of reference from which to integrate important determinants of population health.
Dysfunction parallels a state of “dis-ease”; and prolonged -dysfunction parallels the state of Disease.

Rather than define health as the absence of disease (as seen in BST), notice here how we instead define disease in relation to health; and we define health in relation to maintainability , ease , and functioning .
Precision appears in those functions that prioritize and organize the patterns of variation that can sustain health at a level in future, changing conditions.
Variation appears in the functions of each system that generate a range of abilities, the “varied-abilities”, that sustain health in presently changing conditions.
Vaccine interventions can enhance both the precision of the host-defense functions and variation in the microbiome.
Behavior change interventions can enhance both the precision in one’s decisions and the variation in one’s habits.

Without functional-variation, life is fragile and vulnerable to changing conditions of the present. Without functional-precision, life becomes disorganized from the system’s exposure to changing conditions across time.
Exposure, not avoidance , has facilitated population health in these interventions.

value: The philosophy stops at three levels; changes above and below them are acknowledged but not treated.

value: Variation is not claimed to be good without bound.

value: Technology algorithms that prioritise population behaviours act as society-level precision.

value: Expertise at one level limits the interventions professionals prescribe.
